name: craze
description: Sub-agents for Claude Code that run on other models through craze: delegate a task to a native, Grok, Cursor, Antigravity or Codex session and get its result back. Its skill shows any agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity, Codex or a craze session) how to hand work to another provider through craze, Claude included, and never to its own.
